resources.string: Press a pen button to test it, with the pen near the screen or away from it.
Off (the buttons work only near the screen)
Page down / page up (as on HyperOS)
Stylus buttons (for apps that use them)
Short press with page keys: front button = page down, back button = page up (slides, PDFs, readers, browsers). With custom actions you choose what a short and a double press do.
Front button = first stylus button, back button = second stylus button. The app decides what they do, for example eraser. No actions run here, so they do not interrupt drawing.
Stylus buttons; page down / page up only in the Xiaomi pen apps below (recommended)
Page down / page up in all apps (as on HyperOS)
Apps made for the Xiaomi pen

In these apps, a button press near the screen is page down (front) or page up (back), as on HyperOS: Notein and StarNote use these keys for their pen buttons. Notein and StarNote also see the device Xiaomi Pad 6 by default. If another app needs it, choose Xiaomi Pad 6 for it in Games > Device identity per app. In all apps, page keys near the screen can turn pages while you erase.
Cannot save: Pipa Helper must be installed with the ROM.
Buttons, OPPO Notes, pens without Bluetooth
Battery %1$d %% · buttons, OPPO Notes, other pens
Not connected. Tap to open Bluetooth.
Keeps pen input on for active pens with no Bluetooth link (Lenovo Precision Pen and others). Uses a little more battery. Off = as HyperOS: pen input only while the Xiaomi pen is connected.
In OPPO Notes (pen near the screen, short press)
The pen works as an OPPO pencil here: front button = OPPO double tap, back button = OPPO single click. Other apps get normal stylus buttons.
On now: a game is open
Turns on when a game is open
Turn on only to record a bug. Off = quiet logs, better for the battery.
Compiles the apps now, as Android does at night while charging. Use it after a ROM update: apps start faster.
Optimising apps… You can keep using the tablet.
This takes about 5 to 15 minutes. The tablet can get warm and use more battery while it runs. Best while charging.
Saves the system logs of the last minutes in Download, without personal data. Attach the file to your report.

Do this right after the problem happened.

The file contains the system log, the kernel log, the port logs and Wi-Fi failure logs. Email addresses, account and device names, phone numbers, Wi-Fi names and passwords, MAC addresses and locations are removed. It takes about 30 seconds; a notification shows when the file is in Download.

For a problem that is hard to catch: turn on Detailed system logs first, make the problem happen, then collect.
%1$s. Tap to share it, or attach it to a GitHub report.
Wi-Fi did not start correctly. Tap to collect logs for a bug report.
Saved. Start the game again to use it.
Performance profile, device identity per app
Animation style and speed, blur, contour glow
Once a day when online. Reads one small file from GitHub. Shows a notification only, downloads nothing.
New release: %1$s (%2$s). Tap to see it.
Check failed. Is the tablet online?
No update information is online yet. Nothing to install.
The ROM is up to date
Released %1$s. Tap for the release notes.
%1$s is ready to install. The tablet stays usable; one restart at the end.
Install failed: %1$s. Tap to try again.

Downloads about %1$s and installs it into the second system slot. Your apps and data stay. If the new system does not start, the tablet tries it up to 7 times (hold Power to restart a frozen start), then goes back to the current one.\n\nLinux dual boot: the update replaces the boot image of the other slot. Do not install it if you keep Linux or UEFI there.
This build has no /data encryption (noenc). Update it with the PC scripts.
The tablet restarts into the new system. The first start takes a few minutes.
Dims the screen below the lowest brightness, for reading in the dark. Also a Quick Settings tile.
Off: Extra dim turns off when the tablet restarts.
Low: 2304 × 1440, smoother (fewer pixels for the GPU)
A new animation style applies fully after a reboot. Apply restarts only the status bar and the home screen.
Defaults set. Tap Apply, or reboot to apply them everywhere.
Tap Apply to restart the home screen with the new style. Reboot to apply it everywhere.
Frosted glass behind the shade, folders and menus (ColorOS). On by default.
Light edge around blurred panels (ColorOS). On by default.
Moving blur behind Quick Settings and the notification shade. Costs a little smoothness.
Blur behind dialogs and pop-ups. Off by default: on this GPU it drops frames.
Blur while apps open and close. Off by default: it drops frames on the Snapdragon 870.
Restarts the status bar and the home screen (a few seconds, no reboot).
Applying: the status bar and home screen restart.
The animation and blur settings the port ships with.
Set all animation and blur settings back to the port defaults? Then tap Apply, or reboot to apply them everywhere.

While a game is open, the tablet uses this Xiaomi thermal profile; when you close it, the daily profile comes back. Games are detected automatically (the app says it is a game); tap an app below to add others.
Maximum: no CPU limits below 51 °C (gets warmer)
Off: daily profile also in games

Some games offer higher frame rates or quality only to known gaming devices. The app sees the chosen device; all other apps see the device of the ROM (OPPO OPD2515). Applies the next time the app starts.
Pressing the Super key alone runs this action. Super shortcuts (Super + another key) and holding Super stay as they are.
The animation style is also read by the system and apps at their start.
Do not treat as a game
